WITH sentiment_by_trans AS (
  SELECT 
    sf.transref,
    AVG(sf.shortintrt) as trans_avg_short_int,
    AVG(sf.optvolrt) as trans_avg_opt_vol
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals sf
  GROUP BY sf.transref
),
order_type_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    tr.ordertypedist,
    AVG(sf.shortintrt) as order_type_avg_short_int
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals sf
  JOIN transactionrecord tr ON sf.transref = tr.transreg
  WHERE sf.shortintrt IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY tr.ordertypedist
)
SELECT 
  tr.transreg,
  tr.ordertypedist,
  sbt.trans_avg_short_int,
  sbt.trans_avg_opt_vol,
  CASE 
    WHEN ota.order_type_avg_short_int IS NOT NULL AND sbt.trans_avg_short_int IS NOT NULL
    THEN sbt.trans_avg_short_int / ota.order_type_avg_short_int
    ELSE NULL
  END as ratio
FROM transactionrecord tr
INNER JOIN sentiment_by_trans sbt ON tr.transreg = sbt.transref
LEFT JOIN order_type_avg ota ON tr.ordertypedist = ota.ordertypedist
ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC
